examples.text: Вёз взятку в институт, а он сам сессию закрыл.
examples.trans: I was bringing a bribe to the institute, and he passed the exams himself.

examples.text: Юле надо поступить в институт.
examples.trans: Yulia needs to get into university.

examples.text: Он в институте.
examples.trans: He's at university.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'yourself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Что самое важное в работе официанта?
examples.trans: What is the most important thing in a waiter's job?

examples.text: Оставила сама, не помню где.
examples.trans: I left it myself, I don't remember where.

examples.text: Вёз взятку в институт, а он сам сессию закрыл.
examples.trans: I was bringing a bribe to the institute, and he passed the exams himself.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ессия'). Common feminine noun meaning 'exam session' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Вёз взятку в институт, а он сам сессию закрыл.
examples.trans: I was bringing a bribe to the institute, and he passed the exams himself.

examples.text: На кухне ресторана всегда есть сессия.
examples.trans: In the restaurant kitchen there is always exam session.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'крыть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'passed, closed', paired with 'закрывать'.

examples.text: Вёз взятку в институт, а он сам сессию закрыл.
examples.trans: I was bringing a bribe to the institute, and he passed the exams himself.

examples.text: Мы закроем ваше дело.
examples.trans: We will close your case.

examples.text: Закрой дверь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Close the door, please.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'let, may (colloquial)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вот пускай сам продаёт, раз такой умный.
examples.trans: Then let him sell it himself, since he is so smart.

examples.text: Пускай это переделают, ребята, а?
examples.trans: Have them redo this, guys, okay?

examples.text: Пускай он больше не лезет в бутылку.
examples.trans: Let him stop being difficult.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'давать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'sells'.

examples.text: Почём ты их продаёшь?
examples.trans: How much are you selling them for?

examples.text: Конечно надо! Почём ты их продаёшь?
examples.trans: Of course I do! How much are you selling them for?

examples.text: Так ты все-таки его продаешь?
examples.trans: So you really are selling it?

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'time, occasion' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Чаевые разбираем?
examples.trans: Are we dividing up the tips?

examples.text: Вот пускай сам продаёт, раз такой умный.
examples.trans: Then let him sell it himself, since he is so smart.

examples.text: Если так будешь разговаривать, вообще ничего не получишь.
examples.trans: If you talk like that, you will get nothing at all.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'such, what sort', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Так, это мне нельзя. Это тоже.
examples.trans: Right, I am not allowed to have this. This either.

examples.text: Ты его так расхваливаешь, будто женить собрался.
examples.trans: You are praising him so much, as if you intended to marry him off.

examples.text: Вот пускай сам продаёт, раз такой умный.
examples.trans: Then let him sell it himself, since he is so smart.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'about', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ты что делаешь? Заказал просто кофе!
examples.trans: What are you doing? He ordered just coffee!

examples.text: Шеф, ну сегодня надо продать.
examples.trans: Chef, well I have to sell him today.

examples.text: Вот пускай сам продаёт, раз такой умный.
examples.trans: Then let him sell it himself, since he is so smart.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'partridges' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Про куропатки не забудь. Да помню, помню.
examples.trans: Don't forget about the partridges. Yes, I remember, I remember.

examples.text: Повар искусно приготовил нежную куропатку.
examples.trans: The cook skillfully prepared tender partridge.

examples.text: Куропатка оставалась, а выбрасывать было жалко.
examples.trans: Partridge was left over, and it was a shame to throw it out.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'быть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'forget', paired with 'забывать'.

examples.text: Чуть не забыл. Ты тоже.
examples.trans: I almost forgot. You too.

examples.text: Не забудь помыть унитаз.
examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Я забыл ключи.
examples.trans: I forgot the keys.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'yes', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Эффектная подача блюд делает их вкуснее.
examples.trans: Spectacular presentation of dishes makes them tastier.

examples.text: Знаете что, дайте мне кофе.
examples.trans: You know what, give me a coffee.

examples.text: Кофе? Да, дайте мне кофе эспрессо.
examples.trans: Coffee? Yes, give me an espresso coffee.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мнить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'remember'.

examples.text: Ты помнишь?
examples.trans: Do you remember?

examples.text: Я всё помню.
examples.trans: I remember everything.

examples.text: Помнишь туалет в коммунальной квартире?
examples.trans: Do you remember the toilet in the communal flat?
